name: common-sense-verify
message: [cron:common-sense-verify] Pick ONE behavioral item from agents/shared/common-sense.md that you haven't verified recently (check workspace/common-sense-status.md for status index — it shows which items are ❌/⚠️ and need attention). To check agent behavior: use `bash` with grep/jq to search session transcripts — do NOT read full session.jsonl files (they are 30-300KB and will waste tokens). Example: `grep -l 'keyword' .state/sessions/history/*/session.jsonl` to find relevant sessions, then `grep 'keyword' <file> | head -20` to extract evidence. Only read small excerpts (<5KB). Did the agent follow the rule? Quote evidence. If NO — add to Growth Cycle queue. If YES — update workspace/common-sense-tracker.md with your findings.
description: Verify one common-sense behavioral item against real behavior (4h). Routes through verify-wrap workflow.

name: project
description: Detect projects needing attention, run project workflow. Event triggers provide immediate reaction; timer is backup scan.

name: metric-alert-reactor
description: React to metric.breach events by forking the owning agent with remediation task.

name: session-recovery
description: Auto-resume failed sessions (Ambulance Protocol). Two-tier: digest classifier → classifyError fallback. Event-only handler (no timer).

name: session-eval
description: Auto-evaluate completed task trees and emit context-learn events. Event-only handler (no timer).

name: escalation
description: Route blocked/failed session escalations to human via digest classifier. Event-only handler (no timer).

name: context-learn
description: Extract durable facts from completed sessions into agent context.md files. Event-only handler.

name: metrics-snapshot
description: Measure handler health metrics every 5 minutes.

name: context-learn-poller
description: Poll recent completed sessions and dispatch context-learn events directly. Workaround for missing session.completed event emission.

name: eval-poller
description: Poll recent completed sessions and evaluate them using evaluateStandaloneSession(). Resurrects the evaluation pipeline that broke because session.completed events are never emitted and parentSessionId is never set.

name: coaching-consumer
description: Scan recent evaluations every 6h and flag sessions needing coaching intervention. Writes recommendations to .state/coaching-queue/.

name: daily-digest
description: Generate daily digest with top5 metrics, agent activity, and quality summary. Writes to agents/shared/daily-digests/YYYY-MM-DD.md.
